testCase.name: [dev] S09 Card per context: Hospital card has the diagnosis, Nursing Home card and search hint have none

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B28 · P2 · 已知

养老院卡片显示诊断，养老院搜索也按诊断搜（规格要求不显示、不搜）

票：TFA-92581 AC3 ready for qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：dev

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-01/S02, TC-03/S07

思路 / Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S09 「每个模式的卡片：医院卡片有诊断，养老院卡片和搜索提示没有」 Card per context: Hospital card has the diagnosis, Nursing Home card and search hint have none

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 Nursing Home has no diagnosis: none on the Nursing Home card, and Nursing Home search does not match on diagnosis.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 3）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Standard fixture ({snfResident} has an MRN 'MRN-<6 chars>' and a stored diagnosis, no unit, no facility)

When Open the Hospital list, then the Nursing Home list in Today's Visits and in All Residents, with no search

Then Hospital card shows the diagnosis. The Nursing Home card shows no diagnosis, and the untouched NH search hint does not offer diagnosis, in both views

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: cp1 mustContain {hospitalPatient}, 'Community-acquired pneumonia'. cp2 and cp3 mustContain {snfResident}, 'MRN-' (anchors only, not U6 evidence: 'MRN-' would match any MRN text). They mustNotContain 'Post-acute rehab after hip fracture', {hospitalPatient} and the word 'diagnosis' (U5). …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U01；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S09 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 dev · 票 TFA-92581 ready for qa

医院卡片正确显示了诊断，但养老院卡片也显示了诊断，养老院的搜索提示里也提到了「diagnosis」。

Hospital cards correctly show the diagnosis, but Nursing Home cards show it too, and the Nursing Home search hint mentions 'diagnosis'.

依据：dev U01 (ledger #1). Already in dev report §2 #4, cluster C1 (TFA-92581 AC 3). Facility is not checked here: there is no field (S10).

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。

UAT item: TC-03 Search & Sort · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-03/S09

Tickets: TFA-92581 Search & Sort (ready for qa)

Plan: unit U01 (#1, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Card per context: diagnosis only on Hospital. Its checks read the whole list; another part's patients would change it.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #1, U01; checked: yes): Fail (product) — NH card shows the diagnosis ("Post-acute rehab after hip fracture", inside the resident's own card) and NH search hint offers "diagnosis"; UAT TC-03 "no diagnosis on the Nursing Home card", TFA-92581 AC 3 (ready for qa). Hospital card correct.
